text:
Nina: quick follow-up thread for the midnight route-change that triggered cross-region LB retries and a DNS failover. we need owners, short ETAs, and one mitigation we can flip fast.

Ravi: short root cause: route-change moved traffic to a pool with a mismatched TLS config (different SNI mapping). LBs retried aggressively, amplifying the 5xx spike.

Omar: logs: ```
[edge-4] 2026-07-20T23:41:02Z TLS handshake error: received alert unknown_ca
[lb-main] 2026-07-20T23:41:03Z upstream reset, retry_count=2
```

Nina: Action 1 (owner: Omar) - identify affected pool, rotate certs if needed, attach cert fingerprints to INC-5201. ETA 2026-07-21 10:00 UTC.

Ravi: Action 2 (owner: Ravi) - quick mitigation flag: disable LB client retries for 15m after any automated route-change. Implement as a toggle in lb-config and docs. ETA 2026-07-21 EOD. Note: risk = more visible errors for transient backend failures.

celeste: Action 3 (owner: Celeste) - add a pre-change TLS validation step to the route-change pipeline: do an actual TLS handshake (remote verify) against target pool before commit. ETA 2026-07-27.

Nina: Monitoring: I'll add a short-lived alert net.tls.reset_spike -> page if tls_resets > 0.3% for 10m AND retries/s > 40 for 5m. Probe id: cross-region-tls-2. ETA 2026-07-22.

inc-bot: Ticket INC-5201 created: route-change-tls-mismatch. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INC-5201

Omar: I'll post packet captures and cert chain outputs to INC-5201 after rotation.

Ravi: Also adding to runbook: if route-change needed and certs are invalid -> run `lbctl drain --pool POOL && cert-rotate --pool POOL` then `lbctl enable-retries` after 30m validation. (owner Ravi)

Celeste: Recurrence note: same class as May incidents where automated rebalances didn't validate SNI mapping. Proposal: add a pre-change checklist item to the network change template: "tls handshake ok from 3 regions". I'll add this. ETA 2026-07-29.

Nina: Final checklist:
- [ ] INC-5201 created (inc-bot)
- [ ] rotate certs on affected pool (Omar) - ETA 7/21 10:00
- [ ] LB retry short-disable flag (Ravi) - ETA 7/21 EOD
- [ ] pre-change TLS handshake test (Celeste) - ETA 7/27
- [ ] alert + probe (Nina) - ETA 7/22
- [ ] pre-change checklist item in network template (Celeste) - ETA 7/29

Nina: please update INC-5201 as you make progress. we'll do a 20m sync Friday 2026-07-23 14:00 UTC to confirm closures. thanks :white_check_mark:

Omar: rotating certs now, will update ticket when fingerprint posted.
